snippet.title: Duck Side of the Moon Demo Trailer | Wholesome Games Celebration
snippet.description: Duck Side of the Moon's demo has been released as part of the Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam! Live now through August 14, this event features world premiere game announcements, new releases, discounts, and demos: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames
